newsitem.title: UK: Coventry City undecided on float plans.
newsitem.headline: Coventry City undecided on float plans.

text.p: Football club Coventry City has no definite plan to join the stock market, although it is considering a listing, the club's financial adviser said Monday.
"They've been considering a flotation, as has pretty well every other club in the first division," said Glenn Cooper, director at Apax Partners Corporate Finance.
He added that a press report that the club was seeking a listing on the stock market was "premature". The Times newspaper said the club was planning a 30 million stg flotation in April.
"The club is looking at what it is going to do and has not yet made up its mind what or when," Cooper said.
If Coventry City does decide to list, it will join the growing number of football clubs coming to the market.
Among the recent newcomers to the market are West Bromwich Albion and Sunderland. Birmingham City and Newastle are among the clubs planning to come to the market this year.
